# Hand-authored Converse fixture

This exchange is HAND-AUTHORED, not recorded: Bedrock refuses recording
without live credentials, and this fixture exists so the replay path runs in
CI with no network and no spend.

`make record-fixtures` is the only way to replace it. The record target
refuses to run unless `KNO_LIVE_TESTS=1` AND `KNO_RECORD_FIXTURES=1` are both
set AND `KNO_MAX_COST_USD` is set to a cap the target actually reads. Without
all three it skips — it never dials a live endpoint by accident.

The usage figures are chosen so the settlement arithmetic is exact: 1000
input + 100 cache writes + 500 cache reads = 1600 billed input tokens, 200
output. The request body must match what the replay test configures: model
`anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0`, system prompt "S", maxTokens
1024, input "hello".
